verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents an official MCP server that connects AI tools like Cursor, VS Code, and Claude to GrowthBook. It loads GrowthBook Agent Skills and makes authenticated calls to the REST API, and a probe confirms the dedicated MCP docs page. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration of an agent connecting through the MCP server, and documented detail on the exposed tool inventory and setup steps.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect AI tools like Cursor, VS Code, and Claude to GrowthBook using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
The official GrowthBook MCP server is a thin bridge: it loads GrowthBook Agent Skills (workflows and guardrails) and makes authenticated calls to the GrowthBook REST API.
